authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / authoritative local planning authority providers / Historic England
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 10,667 conservation areas from 152 providers, including authoritative local planning authority sources, while explicitly warning that the aggregate dataset is incomplete and contains duplicates. A bounded window of at most 50 candidate records was considered solely to resolve the fixed future_growth_3 partition/geography. Round61 remote checkpoint/readback still exposes no authoritative conservation-area reference, organisation/local-authority identifier, local-plan reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector binding any candidate area to this fixed slot. Choosing one would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id or Polygon/MultiPolygon is selected, no AAYS_SOURCE_AREA_V1 record is accepted, no canonical parcel is accepted, and no future_growth_new Plan0 package is emitted.
